result:
QA-90072 is **FAIL (data variance)**, and the call is borderline. The report is at `results/2026-10-22/QA-90072-report.md`.

- **Reels first post:** LFM shows Reactions 373,304, Comments 2,485 and Shares 58,110.
- **Native Instagram page:** the visible counter shows 430.8K likes and "2K" comments, so LFM likes are 13.3% lower. The page's meta description says 220K likes and 2,006 comments, which would put LFM comments 23.9% higher. Shares aren't public logged-out, so that assertion is not evaluable.
- **Why borderline:** the spec gives no threshold, so I treated more than 10% as a big variation. The two native counters on this post disagree with each other, so a human should confirm on a logged-in Instagram session.
- **Other reels:** as supplementary evidence only, I also read posts #2 and #3. LFM likes were below the visible native counter by 9.1% and 26.7%.
- **Open bug APPS-60871:** I ran the case anyway, because that bug only puts dashes on Plays, Initial and Replays. The compared metrics rendered as numbers, so it didn't affect the verdict. This departs from Rule 7 in `spec-adherence-rules.md`, which says to auto-fail any case with an open linked bug. I followed your open-bug memory and this run's brief instead, and the report notes it.
- **Not done:** no Jira bugs were filed, and skill/registry maintenance is left for `harvest.sh`.
